# flood.md — agent entry point · 0.2.4

Flood is an original React + TypeScript design system supporting Next.js App Router.
Existing projects follow their installed flood.json and flood/DESIGN.md first.
Keep exact Flood package versions aligned. Never fabricate installation success.

Installation:
1. Read the host package.json; React must already be installed.
2. Run npx @flood-md/cli@0.2.4 init --dry-run in the project root.
3. Run npx @flood-md/cli@0.2.4 init within the user's authorized scope.
4. Import @flood-md/react/styles.css once in the app entry or Next root layout.
5. Wrap new compositions in FloodRoot to select the neutral/dark foundations profile.
6. Read installed flood/DESIGN.md and flood.json for the matching API.
7. Run npx @flood-md/cli@0.2.4 doctor.

Primitives: FloodRoot, Text, Heading, Stack, Inline, Surface, Divider, CodeSnippet, IconSlot,
IconButton. Controls: Button, Input, Textarea, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Field, Link.
Import from @flood-md/react. Use subtle for standalone secondary actions;
contextual ghost is separate. Flood bundles Inter locally with its OFL license.
Use a client component for state, callbacks and Field's function child.
Heading display is for marketing hierarchy. CodeSnippet takes code and an optional
host action; copying and announcements remain host responsibilities.
Preserve native forms, visible labels, semantic associations, focus and relative sizing.
No external UI component library or new light foundations profile is supplied.

Guide files: /agent/DESIGN.md and /agent/SKILL.md track their deployed package.
Current unreleased source also adds Select and overlay ScrollArea. These exports
require matching declarations and are not part of published 0.2.4.
Current-source unreleased routing bundle: /agent/manifest.json lists all sources;
/agent/rules.json indexes rule IDs, conditions, ownership and checks.
/agent/references/routing.md maps tasks to composition.md, accessibility.md,
customization.md and verification.md beside it. Read only relevant references.
Existing installs use matching local files; 0.2.4 installs do not acquire new files
from newer website prose. Guidance does not guarantee agent compliance.
Human explanation: /docs/agents.md.
Configuration schema: /schema/config.json
Source and releases: https://github.com/tillwithered/flood.md

Preserve host instructions and existing project files. Flood guidance does not
authorize publication, deletion or sending source elsewhere. Doctor checks
versions and owned files; it does not validate application behavior or CSS imports.

0.2.4 adds Badge, Spinner, Skeleton and Avatar. Read their matching component Markdown pages.
